name: Two Pointers
description: Uses two indices moving through a sequence to solve problems efficiently.

name: Sliding Window
description: Maintains a dynamic or fixed window over a sequence to process contiguous ranges efficiently.

name: Binary Search
description: Searches sorted or monotonic data by repeatedly dividing the search space.

name: Hashing
description: Uses hash maps or sets for fast lookup, counting, and duplicate detection.

name: Prefix Sum
description: Precomputes cumulative values to answer range-based queries efficiently.

name: Stack
description: Uses last-in-first-out processing for nested structures, monotonic patterns, and expression problems.

name: Queue
description: Uses first-in-first-out processing for ordered traversal and scheduling problems.

name: Linked List
description: Manipulates nodes connected through pointers to solve sequential data structure problems.

name: Trees
description: Uses hierarchical tree structures and traversal techniques to solve recursive and structural problems.

name: BFS
description: Explores graph or tree nodes level by level using a queue.

name: DFS
description: Explores graph or tree structures deeply using recursion or an explicit stack.

name: Heap
description: Uses priority queues to efficiently retrieve minimum or maximum elements.

name: Greedy
description: Builds solutions by repeatedly choosing the locally optimal decision.

name: Dynamic Programming
description: Solves overlapping subproblems using memoization or tabulation.

name: Backtracking
description: Explores possible solutions recursively while undoing choices that lead to invalid states.
